label: kimi-k3-m5-qualification
onstart:
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 tmux build-essential ca-certificates curl git tar
mkdir -p /workspace/kimi/ops /workspace/kimi/artifacts /workspace/kimi/control /workspace/kimi/data /workspace/kimi/runs /workspace/kimi/backup_staging /workspace/kimi/reports /workspace/kimi/cache
printf '%s\n' 'Kimi workspace prepared; bootstrap and qualification are separate explicit commands.'
